name: en_fr_translation
description: Translate a common English noun to French in a few-shot list. Control: same list format but English->English (copy).
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
P=[('dog','chien'),('cat','chat'),('house','maison'),('water','eau'),('bread','pain'),('book','livre'),('tree','arbre'),('car','voiture'),('sun','soleil'),('moon','lune'),('city','ville'),('friend','ami'),('woman','femme'),('man','homme'),('child','enfant'),('apple','pomme'),('cheese','fromage'),('door','porte'),('window','fenêtre'),('school','école'),('flower','fleur'),('sea','mer'),('night','nuit'),('day','jour'),('hand','main'),('head','tête'),('horse','cheval'),('bird','oiseau'),('milk','lait'),('wine','vin'),('king','roi'),('road','route'),('heart','cœur'),('time','temps'),('world','monde'),('love','amour')]
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
    ex=random.sample(P,4); q=random.choice([p for p in P if p not in ex])
    items.append({"prompt":''.join(f"English: {a}\nFrench: {b}\n" for a,b in ex)+f"English: {q[0]}\nFrench:","answer":" "+q[1]})
for i in range(120):
    ex=random.sample(P,4); q=random.choice([p for p in P if p not in ex])
    control.append({"prompt":''.join(f"English: {a}\nEnglish: {a}\n" for a,b in ex)+f"English: {q[0]}\nEnglish:","answer":" "+q[0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
